WindowMemory display hardware control

The optional Apple Silicon IOAVService and Intel IOKit I2C transports
reference the display-control implementations of:

- m1ddc by waydabber and contributors (MIT):
  https://github.com/waydabber/m1ddc
- MonitorControl by the MonitorControl contributors (MIT):
  https://github.com/MonitorControl/MonitorControl

Their license notices are included in this directory. WindowMemory does not
install either utility, invoke external helpers or require Homebrew.
